caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless, fitted vest with a wide, pointed lapel collar. The vest is shown from the front and is composed primarily of a pale cream or beige fabric down the sides and back, with a central panel and collar in a lighter shade decorated with a floral pattern. The floral pattern consists of small, pinkish-red flowers with green leaves distributed evenly across the front central panel and onto the lapels. There are five round buttons running vertically down the front of the vest, from the chest to the midsection. The inside of the collar is rendered in a solid, pale shade. The drawing background is plain with a gradient from very light beige at the bottom to a slightly darker beige at the top. The artist’s name, "Sara Garfinkel," is written in small text in the lower left corner.
title: Waistcoat
